The '''1992–93 Algerian Championnat National''' was the 31st season of the [[Algerian Championnat National]] since its establishment in 1962. A total of 16 teams contested the league, with [[MC Oran]] as the defending champions, The Championnat started on [[october 26]], [[1992 in association football|1992]]. and ended on [[october 21]], [[1993 in association football|1993]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Algeria 1992/93 |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/alg93.html |access-date=2022-11-16 |website=www.rsssf.org}}</ref>
